pageCache.pageTitle: Hendon Prep School - Private School in North London
pageCache.text:
Welcome to Hendon Prep
Hendon Prep is a small, co-educational independent day school and preschool in North London for children aged 3 to 11. At Hendon Prep, our mission is simple yet powerful: to Empower, Inspire and Include.
We ignite personalised learning journeys that enable every child to transform their strengths into excellence, their passions into achievement, and their potential into success. Through expert teaching and innovative digital tools, we inspire exceptional progress and prepare pupils with confidence for the world of tomorrow. We celebrate diversity and nurture a truly inclusive environment one where every child feels secure, valued, heard and happy.
Alongside our excellent academic reputation and outstanding 11+ outcomes for families who prefer not to follow the 11+ exam route, we offer an automatic transfer pathway to Mount House School, also part of the Blenheim Schools Group. So, at Hendon Prep, you genuinely get the best of both worlds: a traditional prep school also with a through‑school pathway that gives your child real choice at 11+.
• Empower Personal Growth • Inspire Through Innovation • Include Every Voice
Our recent ISI Inspection Report highlighted the exceptional care and nurture our pupils receive. It affirmed our core belief: when a child is known, understood, and valued, they flourish discovering their passions and grow in confidence. Our small class sizes ensure this. Our teachers inspire curiosity, celebrate individuality, and guide children to discover their strengths.
Learning at Hendon Prep is personalised, never rushed, and never one‑size‑fits‑all. Childhood is preserved and cherished. We prepare pupils for a future that demands creativity, critical thinking, digital fluency, empathy, and resilience.
At Hendon Prep, every child is empowered to thrive today, tomorrow, and beyond.
Our ongoing investment reflects our commitment to excellence. Developments include an immersive classroom, the creation of the FAB Lab, innovation hub, major playground enhancements, a home-to-school bus service, a redesigned Learning Hub, and a bespoke Early Years environment.
Prepared for
ACADEMIC SUCCESS
Our broad and creative curriculum challenges pupils on a daily basis, building confidence and curiosity and helping them to discover a life-long love of learning.
Prepared for
PUPIL WELLBEING
As a school which values academic attainment and pupil wellbeing equally, the environment we have created at Hendon Prep ensures that every child feels valued, included, and represented.
Prepared for
11 PLUS
Hendon Prep pupils consistently achieve excellent results at 11+, enabling them to move on to some of the most selective senior schools in the country.
Join us for a Personal Tour
Unlocking Every Child's Potential
Come experience the warmth and dedication of our Hendon Prep community and see first-hand how we nurture and develop the potential of all our children.
Excellent Senior School Destinations: 2026
Hendon Prep Year 6 pupils consistently receive offers from top Senior Schools. Through hard work, determination, and the support of our dedicated staff, they secure a fantastic range of offers from leading senior schools - including a number of highly competitive scholarships.
FACILITIES & LOCATION
Situated in the leafy north London suburb of Hendon
The school provides a fantastic range of facilities to enhance pupils’ learning and experience. We have bright and well-resourced classrooms, complete with an ICT suite, dedicated Art and Design studio, music room, library and a fully equipped science laboratory. A large playground and outside classroom give pupils much needed space for play and outdoor learning. With a planting area, amphitheatre, Astroturf football and netball pitch and giant chess board, playtimes are full of fun at Hendon Prep. Besides using the wonderful playground for sports and PE lessons, the school also makes use of fabulous local facilities such as Poolside Manor Swimming Pool and Power League.
Awards
We are delighted to have been named a Finalist for “Best Use of Education Technology” at the Independent Schools of the Year Awards 2025! This recognition reflects of our innovative use of educational technology. EdTech is embedded in every aspect of learning — from AI-powered platforms and wellbeing tools to online safety and inclusion initiatives — empowering pupils to think critically, lead with courage, and shape technology with purpose.
We're thrilled to announce that Hendon Prep has been named a Finalist in the Muddy's Best School Awards 2024 for Best Experiential Learning! Judges were impressed by our innovative teaching methods and engaging learning opportunities that extend beyond the classroom. This award is a testament to our Enrichment Afternoon initiative, reflecting the dedication of our teaching team and students who collaboratively developed it to enhance our dynamic and inclusive curriculum.
We are proud to have been Highly Commended for Excellence and Innovation in Mental Health and Wellbeing at the ISA Awards 2026. This recognition celebrates the care woven into every school day, from the relationships our teachers build with each child to the friendships fostered through our houses and the close partnership we share with families.
We are proud to be an accredited recipient of the National Wellbeing Award for Schools. This significant recognition reflects our ongoing commitment to promoting positive mental health and emotional wellbeing across our whole school community. We are dedicated to creating a nurturing environment where every child feels safe, valued, and supported to flourish both academically and emotionally.

pageCache.pageTitle: Creative & Performing Arts - Art, Music & Drama at Hendon Prep
pageCache.text:
Creative Arts & Music
Art, Music and Drama are essential parts of life at Hendon Prep
Drama, Art and Music thrive at Hendon Prep and are an important part of school life, both in the curriculum and at after-school clubs. Our innovative teachers are constantly looking for new initiatives to help our pupils develop their creativity, encouraging them to find and follow their passions. Many children take individual instrument lessons, join the choir or have LAMDA lessons. All pupils from Reception to Year 6 take part in at least one assembly per year, which they perform in front of other pupils and their parents. Pupils are given the opportunity to develop their skills and perform in front of an audience in a supportive environment.
Art
Music
Drama
Pupils engage in authentic art experiences
Creativity thrives here at Hendon Prep where children from Reception to Year 6 have weekly art and design lessons with our specialist teacher in our dedicated, well-resourced, art studio. Children are encouraged to explore a range of mediums during their lessons and examine different artists and their work in an historical and global context. We constantly change the projects children work on to ensure that they are fresh and relevant to the world around us.
Music plays a huge part in school life
Pupils from Preschool to Year 6 have music lessons with our Head of Music every week. Music lessons help our children to develop their confidence and self-esteem, foster team working skills and creativity, and they also provide our children with a huge amount of enjoyment. Alongside timetabled music lessons there are many co-curricular opportunities to take part in music, including our choir, handbells club, string group, guitar ensemble, individual instrumental lessons and opportunities to perform at our wonderful tea-time concerts, carol concerts and end of year performances.
Developing confidence from day one
Designed to promote student confidence, creativity and imagination, Drama enables our children to develop a wide variety of essential life skills, including co-operation, collaboration, and communication. Drama is added to the timetable as a discrete subject from Year 3 and many pupils from 3 years old also opt to take additional LAMDA (London Academy of Music and Dramatic Art) lessons. LAMDA is the UK’s largest Speech and Drama board and a nationally recognised qualification in communication and performance.

Sport
Supporting a healthy and active lifestyle
We are keenly aware that regular exercise is crucial to support both physical and mental wellbeing, and that it is hugely important to embed healthy routines from a young age. It is also essential that the very youngest members of our school take part in regular sport and PE sessions to support the development of both their gross and fine motor skills. From our well-loved school sports day through to fixtures and competitive opportunities with other schools, we enjoy a sporting culture that is embraced by students of all ages, resulting in young people who are keen to pursue an active lifestyle when they leave us.
A STRUCTURED PROGRAMME
Sport and PE is taught by a subject specialist
Through our structured programme developed by our Head of Sport, children learn to develop key sporting skills and techniques whilst focussing on the ‘ABCs’ of athletic ability – Agility, Balance, Co-ordination and Speed. In lessons, Sport and PE is taught in co-educational groups so that all pupils have the opportunity to enjoy the sports on offer. In the Prep school lessons include, swimming, football, cricket, netball, tag rugby, hockey, tennis and athletics. In the Pre-Prep pupils take part in dance, gymnastics, yoga, mini tennis and cricket, football and athletics, with children in Year 2 also taking swimming lessons for one term per year. Besides making full use of our wonderful playground, we also utilise excellent local facilities such as Poolside Manor swimming pool and Powerleague.

pageCache.pageTitle: Private School Admissions Process - Hendon Prep School
pageCache.text:
Admissions Process
Joining us is straightforward
Apply for a place at our exceptional school and give your child the best possible start to their educational journey. We have designed our admissions process to be as easy as possible and we will happily guide you every step of the way.
Children can join our Preschool class at the start of the term in which they are 3 years old.
Contact a member of our Admissions Team to find out more about our wonderful school and check availability.
We run open events and private tours throughout the academic year. Open events are a great opportunity to see the school in action, speak to our Senior Leadership Team, our Admissions Team and hear from current pupils.
When you're ready to take the next step, we will ask you to complete the registration form, and make a non-refundable, £120 Registration fee payment. This will enable us to start our admission process to ensure that we can meet your child's needs. Forms need to be signed by both parents and may be returned by post, or scanned copies by email.
For Preschool Following registration, you and your child will be invited to an informal admissions meeting. You will have the opportunity to meet with the Headteacher and our Early Years Lead to discuss your child and the potential offer of a place. Our Admissions Manager will also be on hand to guide you through the final steps of the application process. For Reception Following registration, you and your child will be invited to an informal admissions meeting. During this visit, you will meet with the Headteacher, and your child will take part in a SENDCo assessment as part of the admissions process. You may be asked to share your child’s most recent school report in advance. Our Admissions Manager will also be on hand to guide you through the final steps of the application process and offer of a place.
Once we receive your completed Acceptance Form and relevant deposits, we will send you confirmation of your child’s place in the school.
Chance vacancies
From time to time we do have places become available throughout the year from Reception to Year 6. Should you wish your child to be considered for one of these places we would ask that you visit the school and register your child with us. Following Registration we ask for copies of your child’s latest school reports and arrange for them to sit an age appropriate assessment in Maths and English. Once these assessments have been returned to school and marked, we will invite your child into school for a Taster Session. Please note that in ALL cases, assessments and subsequent offers are booked and made in order of application.
Early Years’ funding available
We are delighted to announce that Early Years’ funding is now available to all 3 and 4 year olds in Preschool*. This government funding, often referred to as ’15 hours free funding’, is available to every child from the term after they turn 3, and in an independent school setting, equates to a saving of approximately £900 per term for parents. Please contact our Admissions Team directly to find out more. *Terms & conditions apply.
International Admissions Process
Hendon Prep holds highly trusted sponsor status with the United Kingdom Visas and Immigration (UKVI). We are able to support your child with a Tier 4 child student visa. The International Admissions Process and Fees structure differ slightly from that of domestic applicants. Please contact our Admissions Team for more details.
Next Steps
Hendon Prep School

Careers at Hendon Prep
Hendon Prep is a local co-educational school for boys and girls from 3-11 years situated in the suburbs of North West London. We strongly believe that children should be enriched by their educational experiences and ultimately challenged to fulfil their unique potential. Part of the Blenheim Schools Group, Hendon Prep is a vibrant and dynamic place to work with opportunities for professional development both within our school and in the wider Blenheim Schools community.
We look to recruit high-calibre staff who share our values of respect and tolerance, honesty and integrity, and our commitment to creating a stimulating and nurturing environment where academic excellence and personal well-being are valued equally.

pageCache.pageTitle: Independent Schools Inspectorate Reports - Hendon Prep
pageCache.text:
Inspection Reports
ISI INSPECTION REPORT 2026
EXCELLING ACROSS ALL 5 AREAS
In January 2026, Hendon Prep School underwent a comprehensive inspection by the Independent Schools Inspectorate, evaluated against the updated Framework 23 criteria. Notably, under this new framework, overall judgments or grades are no longer provided by ISI. The inspection report is structured around 5 key areas, wherein inspectors meticulously detail commendations for met standards and provide insightful overviews highlighting areas for improvement where standards are not yet met. It brings us great joy to announce that Hendon Prep School has excelled across all 5 stages, achieving a commendable "met" status in each.
ISI INSPECTION REPORT 2023
EXCELLENT IN ALL AREAS
The Independent Schools Inspectorate (ISI), rated Hendon Prep as ‘excellent’ in January 2023. The inspection report concluded that the quality of the pupil’s academic and other achievements is excellent and the quality of the pupils’ personal development is also excellent. A double “excellent” is the highest possible outcome for a school during an Educational Quality Inspection. We are so proud of what the inspectors said about our school and in particular that they recognised that “The school meets its aim to stretch and challenge pupils to achieve the best they can as individual learners”.
ISI Regulatory Compliance Inspection Report 2018
Regulatory Compliance Inspection
In 2018, Hendon Prep School received a Regulatory Compliance Inspection. Both areas met the standards in the schedule to the Education Regulations 2014, following lesson observations, examining samples of pupils’ work and formal interviews with staff, pupils and governors.

Turning Unique Talents Into Remarkable Futures
Everyone is unique. At Blenheim, we recognise all talents and abilities. Nurturing aspirations and building confidence, we accompany each pupil on a deeply personal and ambitious learning journey towards a remarkable future.
A Blenheim Education
An Education With Purpose.For a Life of Possibilities
We know that children learn best when they are happy and engaged. Our schools are vibrant communities built on friendship and kindness. Imagination and playfulness are woven into school life and our diverse curriculum enables pupils to explore new experiences and discover new passions. Education is a precious and exhilarating journey of self-discovery, and we want pupils to thrive socially and emotionally, as well as academically.
We’re here to inspire a lifelong love of learning in every pupil. Through our rich curriculum and highly individualised teaching, we help them develop genuine intellectual curiosity and academic confidence. With life skills embedded into every lesson, pupils are challenged and inspired to think deeply and critically, solve problems and communicate effectively – a solid foundation for their lives ahead.
Nurturing Their Extraordinary
Our classrooms are creative and stimulating places in which to learn. We celebrate effort, welcome debate and see mistakes as part of the journey to improvement. Pupils are encouraged to aim high, rise to the challenge and take pride in their achievements. At the same time, they learn the lifelong value of collaboration, empathy and mutual respect, crucial qualities that will stand them in good stead.
LIFE-READY LEARNERS
The future is complex and fast-changing. Young people need future-ready skills, in addition to strong academic achievement. A successful and fulfilling adulthood is built on a well-rounded education, imbued with moral values, sound judgement and self-discipline grounded in self-worth. A Blenheim education equips them with all of these qualities and many more.
The future is theirs to embrace and the possibilities are endless. Together, let’s make sure they’re ready for it.
Hendon Prep School

pageCache.pageTitle: Academic Excellence & Curriculum - Hendon Prep School
pageCache.text:
Academic Excellence
We are the school of choice for parents in North London who share our belief in developing the potential of every child.
At Hendon Prep, we have been nurturing independent minds for over 150 years preparing our pupils for lives of significance at some of Britain’s very best senior schools since 1873. And just as on the day we welcomed our very first cohort, the Hendon Prep approach today continues to place each individual child at its heart with personalised learning that sets every pupil on a pathway to high academic achievement.
We offer a stimulating and exciting curriculum in well-resourced classrooms
Lessons focus on personalised learning and are taught in small groups and delivered by subject specialists who have the direct responsibility for the teaching and learning of all children in their care. Teaching is creative and imaginative and we set high academic expectations for all our pupils, not-withstanding that we are academically non-selective. We are experienced in planning and preparing our children for the 11+ transition to some of the most selective senior schools. We go beyond timetabling for core subjects by also adding enrichment programmes without sacrificing academic excellence in English, Maths and Verbal and Non-Verbal Reasoning. Our talented and innovative teachers challenge pupils on a daily basis, building confidence and curiosity helping them to develop a life-long love of learning.
PERSONALISED LEARNING
How we teach
Personalised Learning
11+ Preparation
Ed Tech
Attainment Tracking
Preparing our pupils
Our approach is built around educating every child using a personalised learning approach which is designed to give everyone who comes to our school the care and attention they need to be happy and successful. All our children are encouraged to take risks and to be confident independent learners. We want our children to engage enthusiastically with knowledge and to embrace new ideas and to be intellectually stimulated and extended beyond their age.
Helping pupils fulfil their potential
Here at Hendon Prep, we value the fact that pupils bring to school different experiences and strengths that influence the way they learn. We are committed to identifying each pupil’s individual learning needs and we offer provision that is flexible and varied to ensure that children work at age-related expectations or above and achieve their personal potential, whatever their needs and abilities.
The pursuit of the highest achievements
We believe that all children are entitled to an education that will enable them to develop to their full potential, be that intellectual, physical, aesthetic, creative, emotional, spiritual or social. We are committed to providing a stimulating and suitably challenging curriculum for all our pupils, in the pursuit of the highest academic and pastoral achievements. Able, gifted and talented (AG+T) pupils should be given the opportunity to access an optimal breadth and depth of learning; as such we aim to provide opportunities to develop specific skills and talents.
Join us for a Personal Tour
Unlocking Every Child's Potential
Come experience the warmth and dedication of our Hendon Prep community and see first-hand how we nurture and develop the potential of all our children.
Early Years Foundation Stage Profile Results
Year on Year our EYFS results continue to exceed national and local averages.
We’re proud that our EYFS results continue to exceed national and local averages. In 2025–26= 91% of our Reception children achieved a Good Level of Development with consistently strong results over the last several years. A Good Level of Development (GLD) is awarded to children who meet the Early Learning Goals across the five key areas of the EYFS curriculum: - Personal, Social and Emotional Development - Physical Development - Communication and Language - Literacy - Mathematics These results reflect the strong foundations we lay in our Early Years setting, supporting each child’s growth, confidence and love of learning.
Our 11+ preparation programme is well established to meet the challenges of 11+ entrance examinations
The preparation towards 11+ at Hendon Prep is not limited to 2 year cramming, but scaffolded from Year 1, placing our knowledge of each individual child and family at the heart of the process, and reducing the need for stress, supporting well-being. The children are taught to use and apply their knowledge in both exam papers and interviews and their exam technique has been developed throughout their time in our Prep school with termly ISEB Assessments from Year 3 in the core subjects, as well as a range of online annual assessments, so that they feel confident and well prepared.
Supporting a digital learning journey
We have a balanced approach to technology here at Hendon Prep, using it to supplement and extend traditional teaching methods but always with an eye on children’s ‘screen time’ and supported with lessons on internet safety. Technology allows us to deliver great teaching and learning but as a platform for collaboration and productivity. We have witnessed first-hand the positive impact it can have, putting pupils at the heart of their learning by increasing engagement, developing intrinsic interpersonal skills, and preparing them for the future of adult life. We use a variety of platforms and resources to support the learning and educational experience of our children, including Learning by Questions, Century Tech, Firefly and Microsoft Teams. All our classrooms now have interactive whiteboards which are used by even the youngest members of our school in the Preschool class. Children from Preschool to Year 2 also use school iPads on a regular basis.
1:1 Digital Devices
We have also taken the next step in our digital learning journey by providing pupils in Year 3 and above with a laptop. We believe that 1:1 devices are powerful tools that augment and transform the learning experience while offering the best possible resilience against any disruption to pupils’ educations. They will be used in balance with other teaching methodologies and woven into lessons in a planned and meaningful way to support the learning outcomes.
We welcome children of all abilities into our inclusive school
Thanks to our impressively high teaching standards we see our pupils excel across all core subjects, plus sports and creative and performing arts. Our success is boosted by a robust process for tracking pupil attainment (ensuring we have a detailed record of every child’s progress), plus simple measures such as maintaining an open dialogue with parents so that we can address any areas where children need more support. For pupils who are excelling in specific subjects, we are ready to challenge them and provide the support they need to take their learning above and beyond.

pageCache.text:
Wellbeing & Pastoral Care
The welfare of every child is at the heart of everything we do at Hendon Prep
Our aim at Hendon Prep is to create an environment in which pupils feel safe, happy, secure and valued. The intention of our pastoral care is to prevent problems, both personal and academic, from arising. The invaluable partnership we share with parents plays a pivotal role in creating a cohesive and thriving educational community, where we collectively pave the way for a bright and promising future for our pupils. Join us in shaping a bright and promising future for your child, where their happiness, wellbeing, and success are at the heart of all we do.
Join us for aPersonal Tour
Come experience the warmth and dedication of our Hendon Prep community and see first-hand how we nurture and develop the potential of all our children.
Our staff are passionate about developing pupils’ academic progress and supporting their emotional wellbeing. The role of the class teacher is a hugely important one when it comes to wellbeing, as they are the first person a child sees every day, and this creates familiarity and trust between pupil and teacher.
Pastoral care is enhanced at Hendon Prep through our house system, which provides additional opportunities for both pupils and staff to feel more connected and involved with the school community. It facilitates interaction and discussion with both the youngest and the oldest pupils in our school, and ensures that every child feels valued and part of a tight-knit community.
From Preschool to Year 6, all pupils and staff at Hendon Prep follow our Golden Rules. These rules are based on sound moral values, and they permeate every aspect of school life, providing safe guidelines for everyone to follow. They are clearly depicted around the school and help our children have a clear picture of what good, respectful behaviour looks like to ensure fairness and equality, and help to keep every member of our school happy and safe.
At Hendon Prep, everyone belongs. We pride ourselves on a strong, welcoming community where every pupil, parent, and staff member feels included, valued, and heard. Every opinion matters, and together we create a supportive environment where everyone can thrive.

Hendon Prep is a small, co-educational independent day school and preschool in North London for children aged 3 to 11. At Hendon Prep, our mission is simple yet powerful: to Empower, Inspire and Include.
We ignite personalised learning journeys that enable every child to transform their strengths into excellence, their passions into achievement, and their potential into success. pageCache.pageTitle: 11+ Exam Support & Preparation - Hendon Prep School
pageCache.text:
11+ Preparation
The best of both worlds!
At Hendon Prep, we are proud to be a traditional prep school with an outstanding record of preparing pupils for the 11+ and entry to highly sought‑after senior schools. Academic excellence, outstanding teaching and individual support remain at the heart of everything we do, and our Year 6 pupils consistently excel in the 11+, securing offers from a wide range of leading independent schools. Alongside this strong 11+ provision, we recognise that families value choice. For those who decide that the 11+ route is not the right pathway for their child, we also offer a senior transfer option to Mount House School, part of the Blenheim Schools Group. Blenheim Schools Senior Pathway The Blenheim Schools Senior Pathway provides a smooth and natural transition from Hendon Prep to Mount House School, built on shared values, high expectations and a nurturing ethos and academic excellence. This ensures continuity for pupils who thrive best in a through‑school environment, while keeping the process clear, supportive and stress‑free for families. Importantly, this pathway enhances what we offer at Hendon Prep rather than defining it. Families truly benefit from the best of both worlds: • a rigorous, traditional prep school education with focused 11+ preparation for top schools, and • a high‑quality continuation pathway offering reassurance, flexibility and choice at age 11. Throughout both pathways, we place the wellbeing of each individual child at the centre of our approach, carefully guiding pupils and families to identify the senior school environment in which they will flourish most and achieve their full potential.
Preparation for the 11+ begins in Year 1 and is carefully scaffolded over the years, ensuring that by the time pupils sit the examinations in Year 6, they are confident, capable and well prepared. Pupils are taught not only to acquire knowledge, but to apply it effectively in both examination papers and interviews. They also develop strong exam technique through termly ISEB (Independent School Examination Board) assessments from Year 3 in the core subjects, alongside a range of annual online assessments.
Spanish added to Modern Foreign Languages (MFL), in addition to French, for a global perspective and depth of language learning.
Verbal & Non-Verbal reasoning added to the curriculum for a scaffolded approach to exam prep.
Specialist subject teaching introduced for all subjects for breadth and depth of learning. Drama lessons added to underpin confidence.
Embed and consolidate key skills needed for a successful 11+ academic jump.
Focussed 11+ Prep, including additional after school Prep Club. Parent consultations and focus on 11+ papers and exam technique.
Regular practice papers, after school prep club and interview practice.
Join us for a Personal Tour
Unlocking Every Child's Potential
Come experience the warmth and dedication of our Hendon Prep community and see first-hand how we nurture and develop the potential of all our children.
UNDERSTANDING THE NEXT STEP
Many parents ask about Senior schools and where our children move on to
This is actually quite a complex answer as year on year there are changes in parent aspiration, choice, family need and how society is changing. Some years we have a number of pupils who apply for State Selective schools – some years we have none. We don't have one or two 'feeder schools', we cater to as many schools as our families wish to make applications to each year. Finance and individual family circumstances, as well as 'best fit' for the child all play a part in selecting the next step. This is why at Hendon Prep we work with each family and offer guidance and support to ensure every child has a school that they will flourish in and most importantly be happy at - whether this is at State, State Selective or an Independent Senior School.
We are extremely grateful to Hendon Prep for their support of our admissions process over the past 2 years. By hosting the ISEB Common Pre-Test at their school they enabled their students to sit the test in a familiar and convenient environment. We are delighted that two of their pupils will be joining us in September!
From my experience, Hendon Prep boys and girls thrive during their time at NBH. Our schools share a similar ethos built around mutual respect and a determination that children should enjoy their learning and overall educational experience. Hendon Prep pupils have been superbly prepared by the team at Hendon to meet our shared aim that, your son or daughter will achieve 'more than they ever believed possible'.
It has been my very great pleasure to welcome boys from Hendon Prep to Habs over the years! Hendon Prep have prepared some outstanding boys for life at Habs and we very much look forward to next September as we plant the next 160 Year 7 acorns!
